correctness.rationale: Averaging identity iff conjugation-equivariance under generated image; every subgroup of D_{2p} for odd prime p is 1, Cp, one of p reflection C2s, or G. Counts follow by orbit functions and centralizers. Full automorphism orbits follow by explicit AGL(1,p) stabilizer actions and Burnside with correct fixed-point counts. Separate executable enumerates generated-image maps and directly checks all identities and automorphism orbits at p=3,5, matching (129,51,60,25) and (15965,3305,3969,824). Tests are finite corroboration only; proof is general.

value.rationale: The natural finite-group averaging-operator census is classified for an infinite nonabelian family, including pointed versions and full automorphism-moduli counts. Burnside orbit counts involve a nontrivial cyclic necklace polynomial and arithmetic divisor sum, and the p=5 orbit data are not simply determined by the S3 example. These exact invariants provide tractable benchmarks for averaging group structures and automorphism quotient classifications.
